cap: Read the grid by column to see what each method contains and by row to see how often it fails in real life. The top row holds only progestin-only and nonhormonal methods, the long-acting reversible methods and sterilization, because they need no action from the user. Every estrogen method sits in the middle row, and every estrogen contraindication, from smoking after 35 to migraine with aura, applies to that whole column.
